residual_findings.title: No standardized error envelope across Local API handlers
residual_findings.scope: All Local API handlers — error body format varies (plain string vs JSON object)
residual_findings.note: No shared ErrorResponse schema. Handlers return (StatusCode, String) tuples with varying body formats. Add shared ErrorResponse schema in schemas/local-api/common/ with code (stable error code), message, and optional details. Requires handler audit. Defer to V1.64+.
residual_findings.closure_note: V1.64 P0 (Track B): schemas/local-api/common/error-response.schema.json authored ({code, message, details?}) + drift entry. Core CRUD handlers route via NexusApiError→ApiErrorResponse. Orchestration handlers (schedules/sessions/presets) still use ad-hoc (StatusCode, String) — registered as R-V164-FE1-ORCH (V1.65+ refactor). Schema-level standardization complete.

residual_findings.title: Findings list-response schema missing
residual_findings.scope: schemas/local-api/findings/ — list-findings-query exists but no list-findings-response

residual_findings.closure_note: V1.64 P0 (Track B): list-findings-response.schema.json authored + /v1/local/works/{work_id}/findings endpoint implemented (cursor-based, returns {items, pagination}).

residual_findings.title: No sort parameters defined in any list query schema
residual_findings.scope: All Local API list-query schemas — no sort_by/sort_order params
residual_findings.note: No resource supports sort_by/order/direction query parameters. When sort is added, standardize on sort_by: string + sort_order: 'asc' | 'desc'. Defer to V1.64+.
residual_findings.deferral_note: V1.64 Web UI (P2) covers via client-side sort for small lists; structural server-side sort deferred to V1.65+ per compass §5 item #1 (Track C).
residual_findings.closure_note: Closed by V1.67 P0 (local API surface convergence).

residual_findings.title: Response array key naming inconsistent (works/schedules/sessions/capabilities vs items)
residual_findings.scope: All Local API list response schemas — response array key naming
residual_findings.note: Works uses 'works', Schedule uses 'schedules', Sessions uses 'sessions', Capabilities uses 'capabilities'. Cursor-based resources (Creators, KB, Workspaces) use 'items'. Standardize on 'items' for list response arrays. Breaking change requiring handler migration; coordinate with web-ui iteration.
residual_findings.deferral_note: V1.64 P0 closed the pagination half (SURF-001) but explicitly deferred the array rename to V1.65+ per compass §5 item #2; the V1.64 Web UI (P2) covers via a thin TanStack Query transformer adapter.
residual_findings.closure_note: Closed by V1.67 P0 (local API surface convergence).

residual_findings.title: Works uses offset/limit while peers use cursor-based pagination — migrate to cursor-based
residual_findings.note: Works is the only resource using offset/limit + total. All other list-returning resources (creators, kb, workspaces) use cursor-based pagination via shared PaginationInfo. Migrate Works to cursor-based pagination, adding PaginationInfo and changing works → items. Requires handler changes (structural).
residual_findings.closure_note: V1.64 P0 (Track B): Works list migrated to cursor-based pagination ({works, pagination: PaginationInfo}); opaque offset-token cursor (v1:<offset>), limit+1 has_more probe. Pagination only — the works→items rename is F-P3 (SURF-003), still deferred. All in-repo consumers (CLI, tests) updated.
